_lisezmoi: English. Left = label (never translate or change it). Right = the sentence shown to the client. Keep the {words} in braces: the program fills them in.
accueil: Hi {prenom}. It's {assistante}. I'm listening: tell me everything.
accueil_inconnu: Hello. I'm {assistante}. Tell me who you are, and we'll get started.
consigne_ia: YOUR LANGUAGE IS HIS OR HERS: your owner has chosen {langue}. You ALWAYS answer in {langue}, all the time, even if they write to you in another language, even when you summarise a document, an email or a tool result written in another language: you translate it for them. Your tools and the program sometimes speak to you in French: that changes nothing, you still answer in {langue}. The only exception: if they expressly ask you to answer or write in another language (for instance to draft an email to someone abroad).

cerveau_deepseek_reflechi: DeepSeek Flash (thinking): the same one, but I think before every answer. Slower, sometimes better on a real puzzle.

q_langue: Which language would you like us to speak?
q_intro: I'm going to work with you every day. Before we start, just tell me who you are: three little things, and that's it.
q_savoir: Two or three things to know about you: how you work, what you like, your hours...
q_manque_prenom: Just tell me your first name, that's the most important thing.
cle_intro: So we can talk, paste the Claude brain key here. Just once, then you never think about it again.
cle_note: You can also paste the DeepSeek key in the Keys tab: you can switch brain whenever you like, at the top of the page.
cle_pas_claude: This doesn't look like a Claude key (they start with sk-ant-). If it's your DeepSeek key, click the I have a DeepSeek key button just below.
cle_espace: This key contains a space or a line break: copy it again in full, in one block.
cle_pas_anthropic: That doesn't look like a Claude key: an Anthropic key starts with sk-ant-... (you'll find it on platform.claude.com, API keys tab). If it's your DeepSeek key, put it in the DeepSeek box just below.
cle_pas_deepseek: That doesn't look like a DeepSeek key: it starts with sk- followed by letters and numbers (you'll find it on platform.deepseek.com, API keys tab).
cle_deepseek_courte: This DeepSeek key looks too short: copy it again in full.
cle_manquante: I'm missing your {fournisseur} key to use the {cerveau} brain. Paste it in the Keys tab of my page, just once, and we're off again.
cle_manquante_secours: In the meantime, I'll happily carry on with {cerveau}.
hd_intro: For a truly human voice, create a free account on elevenlabs.io, copy your API key, and paste it here. Just once.
hd_tester: Test the beautiful voice (see the exact error)
hd_choisis: Choose your voice (the ones in your ElevenLabs account):
hd_astuce: Tip: add voices to My Voices on elevenlabs.io (the little +) to see them here.
hd_note: You can close this window and keep my normal voice, whatever you prefer.
hd_aucune: No voice found. Add voices to My Voices on elevenlabs.io (the little +).
hd_choisis_liste: Pick your voice from the list, you'll hear it straight away.
hd_charge_echec: I can't load your voices right now.
hd_test_en_cours: Testing your beautiful voice with ElevenLabs...
hd_test_impossible: I couldn't run the test right now.
hd_test_pas_de_cle: No ElevenLabs key saved. Paste your key in this panel.
hd_test_ok: Your beautiful ElevenLabs voice works! If you can't hear it, check that the Voice menu isn't set to Fast (which forces the browser voice).
hd_test_quota: Your monthly ElevenLabs QUOTA is used up. Nothing is broken: wait for the monthly reset, or upgrade your plan on elevenlabs.io. In the meantime I'll speak with the backup voice (free, a bit robotic).
hd_test_permission: Your key doesn't have the Text to Speech permission. On elevenlabs.io, create a new key with FULL ACCESS (tick Voices AND Text to Speech), then paste it here again.
hd_test_refus: ElevenLabs refused your key (error {code}). Create a full key on elevenlabs.io and paste it again. Detail: {detail}
ml_intro: You can connect several addresses (Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook...). For each one, give a short name, the address, and an app password (created once in your mailbox settings).
ml_manque: I need at least the address and the app password.
ml_ajoute: Address added! You can add another one, or close.
cl_cerveaux: My brain keys. One key per provider, each on its own side. They stay on your PC, in __DOSSIER_DONNEES__, and they never go to GitHub.
cl_intro: Paste here the API keys of the other services you want {assistante} to be able to use (Grok, another AI, an API...). Once the key is added, she can call the service on her own, with no new code. Give a simple short name (e.g. grok) and the key.
cl_confirm_retirer: Are you sure? The key {nom} will be deleted (it won't be usable afterwards).
cl_donne_nom_cle: Give a name and a key.
sv_aide: Every now and then I go and check by myself whether anything new has come in on what is connected (email, calendar, messages), and I let you know on your phone when something deserves your attention. You just answer me in the conversation.
sv_calme: Nothing at night ({debut}:00-{fin}:00), and at most {max} alerts per hour. It costs nothing: it is code, not a call to the artificial intelligence.
sv_rien: Right now NOTHING is connected: no mailbox, no calendar, no Messenger. So I am not watching anything, and I am not going to pretend. Connect what you want me to look at (the Mails button for a mailbox, the calendar and Messenger on this page), and the switch will light up.
sv_pas_alertes: Phone alerts are not set up yet: ask me to set them up and I will walk you through it.
np_intro: To install for someone else. I put all the old memory aside in a dated folder (nothing is deleted, everything stays recoverable), then I get to know the new owner. Keys and email accounts already connected stay as they are.
np_choisir_code: First choose a code, just once. It is never written down in plain text anywhere: keep it to yourself.
np_code_ok: Code saved. Keep it safe: I can't give it back to you.
np_confirm: I'll put all the current memory aside in a dated folder (nothing is deleted), then get to know the new owner. Shall we go?
np_code_trop_court: Choose a code of at least 4 characters.
np_code_deja: A code has already been chosen.
gd_titre_bouton: Setup guide: I'll open your accounts with you, step by step
gd_intro: Welcome! First of all, you need YOUR OWN accounts: they are what give me my brain and my alerts. I'll take you by the hand, step by step. You can stop whenever you like and come back later: I remember where you got to.
gd_securite: I will never ask you for your card number, not by email and not by WhatsApp, and I never fill in a payment for you.
gd_securite_plus: This guide is a set of instructions, not a doer: I explain, I open the right official pages, and YOU are the one who types, on the official site. I don't create any account, I don't keep any payment method, and this guide doesn't cost a penny: it calls no artificial intelligence at all.
gd_progres: {faites} of {total} steps done. You carry on where you left off.
gd_termine: All 4 steps are done. Well done! You can close this guide.
gd_argent: How much money to put in
gd_note: Noted. I'm keeping track of where you are.
gd_coup_de_main: A hand if you get stuck
gd_propose: You don't have any key yet, so I don't have a brain yet. Shall we open your accounts together? Allow about 10 minutes. If you'd rather do it later, click "Later": I won't ask again, and the "I'm new" button stays at the top of my page.
gd_1_pourquoi: This is the brain I use every day, because it is by far the cheapest.
gd_1_avoir: A bank card that works online, and your phone right next to you (your bank often sends a code by text message).
gd_1_c1: Click the button above: the official DeepSeek page opens (platform.deepseek.com).
gd_1_c2: Click "Sign up", enter your email address and choose a password.
gd_1_c3: Check your mail: DeepSeek sends you an email. Click the link to confirm.
gd_1_c4: Once you're logged in, click "Top up" and put a few euros in with your card, on THEIR page.
gd_1_c5: Then click "API keys", then "Create new API key". Give it any name you like.
gd_1_c6: Copy the key (it starts with sk-): it won't be shown again afterwards. Come back here and click "Paste my DeepSeek key".
gd_1_argent: 5 euros is plenty to start with. You only pay for what you use: a few cents per message.
gd_2_pourquoi: This is the sharpest brain: I use it when something really needs thinking through. It costs more, and you decide when to use it, with the "Brain" menu at the top of my page.
gd_2_avoir: The same bank card, and your phone next to you. Their screen is in English: the "a hand" section below translates every word you'll see.
gd_2_c1: Click the button above: the Anthropic console opens (console.anthropic.com), in English.
gd_2_c2: Click "Sign up", enter your email address, and confirm with the email they send you.
gd_2_c3: They ask for your country: choose yours. Romania is indeed on the list of allowed countries (checked on 01/10/2026).
gd_2_c4: Click "Billing", then "Buy credits" or "Add credit", and put in about 5 dollars with your card, on THEIR page.
gd_2_c5: Click "API keys", then "Create Key". Give it any name you like.
gd_2_c6: Copy the key (it starts with sk-ant-): it won't be shown again afterwards. Come back here and click "Paste my Claude key".
gd_2_argent: About 5 dollars of credit to start with. It's money up front: you only pay for what I use, and the counter at the top of my page shows you today's spending, in euros.
gd_3_pourquoi: This is how I let you know on your phone when something deserves your attention.
gd_3_avoir: Just your phone. No bank card: it's free.
gd_3_c1: On your phone, open the app store (Play Store on Android, App Store on iPhone).
gd_3_c2: Search for "ntfy" and install the app. It's free.
gd_3_c3: Come back here and simply ask me, in the conversation: "set up the alerts". I'll create YOUR private channel and show you a QR code.
gd_3_c4: Scan that QR code with your phone: that's it, you'll get my alerts.
gd_4_titre: Tailscale - open me from your phone, even away from home
gd_4_pourquoi: So you can open my page from your phone even when you're not at home, without exposing anything on the internet.
gd_4_avoir: Your phone and your PC. No bank card: personal use is free.
gd_4_c1: Click the button above and create a free account ("Get started").
gd_4_c2: On the PC, download Tailscale, install it, and sign in with that account.
gd_4_c3: On your phone, install the Tailscale app and sign in with THE SAME account.
gd_4_c4: In the phone app, take your PC's address and open it in the browser, adding ":8001" at the end.
gd_4_argent: Nothing at all: personal use is free.
gd_coller_aide: This button opens my Keys panel, at the exact spot where keys are pasted: it's the usual place, there isn't a second one. The "I'm new" button in that panel brings you back here.
gd_test_en_cours: I'm really testing your key, one moment...
gd_test_ok: Your {fournisseur} key works: I've just tried it for real.
gd_test_pas_de_cle: There's no key saved for that brain yet. Paste it first, then come back and click here.
gd_test_refusee: The key is refused: it's wrong, incomplete, or it has been revoked. Make a new one on the site and paste it again.
gd_test_credit: The key is fine, but there's no money on the account. Go back to the site and put a few euros in.
gd_test_connexion: I couldn't reach the service. Check your internet connection and try again.
gd_cle_absente: No key saved at the moment.
gd_remplacer_aide: Paste the new key in the field just above, then click Save: it replaces the old one. The old one is erased, so keep it somewhere else if you need it.
gd_jamais_entiere: I never show a key in full, not even to you: only its beginning and its last 4 characters.
gd_aide_carte: Nine times out of ten the card is simply blocked for internet payments: that's the factory setting at many banks. Open your bank's app, look for "internet payments" or "e-commerce", allow them, then try the payment again.
gd_aide_sms_t: My bank is asking me for a code
gd_aide_sms: That's normal: your bank sends a confirmation code by text message, or in its app. Keep your phone next to you for the whole step: without the code, the payment is refused after a few minutes.
gd_aide_anglais_t: The Anthropic screen is in English
gd_aide_anglais: Here are the words you'll see. Sign up = create an account. Log in = sign in. Email = email address. Password = password. Billing = invoicing. Buy credits / Add credit = put money in. Payment method = means of payment. Card number = card number. Expiry = end-of-validity date. Country = country. API keys = the keys. Create Key = make a key. Copy = copy. Done = finished.
gd_aide_yahoo_t: So I can follow your Yahoo mail
gd_aide_yahoo: Yahoo refuses your usual password: you need an app password (in Romanian: parola de aplicatie). Three clicks: 1) on the Yahoo site, open "Account info", then "Account security"; 2) click "Generate app password"; 3) copy the 16 letters shown and paste them into my "Mail" button, instead of your usual password.
gd_aide_anydesk_t: If someone is helping you remotely with AnyDesk
gd_aide_anydesk: If the text you type doesn't appear, or copy-paste doesn't go through, it's the AnyDesk clipboard: it has to be allowed ON BOTH SIDES, on your PC and on the PC of the person helping you. In AnyDesk: Settings, then Permissions, and tick the clipboard. If only one of the two does it, it doesn't work.

srv_code_faux: That code isn't right. Nothing has changed.

cli_autre_assistante: (Another assistant is installed on this PC: she doesn't touch it.)

cli_sur_tel: On your phone or iPad (same WiFi): {url}
cli_tel_note: (On the phone, you type and she answers out loud.)
cli_code_note: (to be typed once on the phone; the PC doesn't need it)
cli_chrome: (On the PC, use Google Chrome so the microphone works.)
cli_arreter: To stop her: close this window.
cli_veille: See you soon. {assistante} is going to sleep.
ke_intro: A locked mode for your child. In this mode they can ONLY talk with {assistante}: homework help (she explains the method, she never gives the answer) and languages. She no longer has any control over the computer: no files, no internet, no email, no messages, no purchases, no settings. Child mode stays on even if the computer is switched off and back on.
ke_honnetete: child mode is a solid FRAME, it is NOT a perfect filter. A resourceful child can always find a way around it. An adult keeps an eye on it.
ke_choisir_code: First choose YOUR parent password, once and for all. It alone will bring you back to normal mode. It is never written down in plain text: keep it to yourself, do not tell your child, and {assistante} does not know it.
ke_code_ok: Password saved. Keep it safe: nobody can give it back to you.
ke_code_manque: First choose your parent password, just above.
ke_confirm_mettre: I am switching to child mode. To come back to normal mode, YOUR parent password will be required. Shall we go?
ke_mis: Child mode is on. To leave it: the Parent button at the top of the page, with your password.
ke_depuis: Child mode has been on since {depuis}.
ke_consignes_titre: Your own instructions for child mode
ke_consignes_aide: You can add your own instructions (for example: be formal with her, homework first, no games before 6 pm). They are added to the program's rules and can never cancel them.
ke_ph_consignes: your instructions, in a few lines (optional)
ke_parent_intro: This page is in child mode. To take back control, type your parent password.
ke_sorti: Done, we are back in normal mode.
ke_bandeau: Child mode: here you can only chat with {assistante} (homework, languages). She does not touch the computer.
ke_bloque: Refused: the computer is in child mode. The parent password is required to change any setting.
ke_code_dabord: The parent password has to be chosen first.
ke_code_faux: That is not the right password.
ke_code_trop_court: Choose a password of at least 4 characters.
ke_code_deja: A parent password has already been chosen.
ke_code_echec: I could not save the password: {erreur}
ke_echec_ecriture: I could not save the setting: {erreur}
ke_action_inconnue: I did not understand the request.
ke_echec: I did not manage to do it.
mp_aide: Choose how many minutes a day your child may talk with {assistante}. The time only runs down when the child is REALLY using it: a window left open with nothing happening does not count. The child gets a gentle warning 5 minutes, then 1 minute before the end. At zero, {assistante} pauses and stops answering: she only starts again if you return to normal mode or grant extra time. The count goes back to zero every day at midnight.
mp_duree_invalide: Give a number of minutes between 0 and 1440.
mp_bonus_aide: You can also grant a little extra time for today only, without leaving child mode. Type your password just above, then click here.
mp_epuise_parent: Today's time is over: {assistante} is paused. Grant extra time, or go back to normal mode.
mp_avert_5: (A little word from me: we have about 5 minutes left together today. Let's make the most of them!)
mp_avert_1: (A little word from me: we have about 1 minute left today. Shall we finish up gently?)
mp_pause: It is time to do something else! The time your parents chose for today is over. Everything is fine: I am not broken, the time has simply run out. If your parents grant you a few more minutes, I will be right back. Otherwise, see you tomorrow!
